source.quote: SMSL's own page for the SU-9 ULTRA, read 2026-11-24: « AK4191+AK4499EX to play the full performance of Chips, the distortion is as low as 0.00006%(-124dB) »; « XMOS XU-316, true 32bit USB processing, supports DoP and Native DSD, and PCM reach up to 768kHz and DSD512 »; « USB, Optical and Coaxial support DSD transmission, Coaxial, Optical support DOP64 ».

facts.chip: « AK4191+AK4499EX » - modulator plus converter - with an XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface.

_sixth_on_this_pairing: Sixth record in this catalogue carrying AK4191 + AK4499, after gustard/a26, eversolo/dmp-a8, eversolo/dac-z10, smsl/d400-mk2 and smsl/do300ex. Three makers, six devices, one architecture that `family: akm` cannot express.
